landingHome.problemTitle: Your sales tools each work on their own.
landingHome.problemLead: Email, calls, WhatsApp, CRM and AI each store a piece of the picture. Teams lose time and opportunities.
landingHome.problemCard1Body: An email handled here, a call noted elsewhere, a prospect qualified somewhere else — nobody sees the full picture.
landingHome.problemCard2Body: Classic CRMs demand data entry nobody has time for.
landingHome.problemCard3Body: Not from lack of tools — because they don't communicate.
landingHome.howTitle: Each agent has a clear job.
landingHome.howLead: You don’t need to turn everything on at once: pick the agent for today’s job. They share the same prospect memory.
landingHome.teamTitle: An AI agent team. One goal: find client companies.
landingHome.teamLead: Hunter leads company search. Analyst qualifies, Assistant prepares outreach. Scout adds signals only — it does not replace the client list.
landingHome.teamOrchestra: The orchestrator prioritizes Hunter (companies), then Analyst and Assistant. Scout stays secondary (signals).

faq.a: Yes. You can move to a higher or lower plan from settings at any time.

faq.q: What’s the difference between monthly and yearly?
faq.a: Yearly billing equals 10 months: you save 2 months versus monthly.

faq.q: What happens if I exceed my AI action quota?
faq.a: With soft-cap, you’re notified without a hard cutoff. Pro may allow overage depending on your setup.

faq.q: Do all plans include every agent?
faq.a: Yes. Each plan includes the full solution (Prospecteur, Veilleur, Analyste, Assistant). Only users and AI action quotas change. The Gmail connector starts at Growth.

faq.q: What’s included in the 7-day free trial?
faq.a: The trial activates the full solution with a dedicated quota, whichever plan you pick at signup.
